profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Justworks
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience building REST APIs and single-page apps for clients from non-profits and small businesses to Fortune 500 companies.  Skilled at Ruby, Kotlin, SQL and database design, and Javascript on both sides of the stack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Build systems that automatically analyze a company's digital footprint, including websites, public business profiles, reviews, contact information, and other online signals. These systems combine web crawling, data enrichment, entity resolution, and LLM-powered analysis to identify inconsistencies, assess credibility, and surface indicators of fraud or coordinated abuse.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Node.js · Sidekiq · Go (Programming Language) · Elasticsearch · Google BigQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Manage risk and control debit and ACH payment flows utilizing vendors such as Plaid, Adyen and Treasury Prime in distributed Python services on the Serverless framework enabled by AWS; particularly DynamoDB, SQS and Lambda.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Flask · Serverless Framework · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon SQS · Snowflake · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain legacy Kotlin services along with a Rails application while migrating to Spring Boot and React with Typescript.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · TypeScript · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · Docker Products

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Build event management tools and attendee experiences (gamification, white-label registration, badging) in PHP on the Laravel framework, along with dozens of small client applications from scratch with a variety of backend (Rails, Express) and frontend (everything from jQuery to React) tools to run on smartphones, oversized touchscreens and everything in-between.
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · JavaScript · AngularJS · Ruby · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop client websites built with Wordpress and create mobile-responsive table-based email templates for mixed promotional use.
